instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, medium full shot at eye-level. In a grassy park with a bridge in the background, the bearded man in the white t-shirt (R1) kneels on the grass facing right with his eyes closed in a calm expression. The woman with a shaved head (R2), wearing a pink long-sleeve shirt and grey shorts, stands behind him. She leans over his back, wrapping her arms around his chest in a supportive embrace. The scene is illuminated by bright, natural daylight with soft shadows and a muted, desaturated color palette.
